title: Rotational Kinetic Energy
text: The rotational kinetic energy can be calculated using the formula $$E_{\text{rot}}=\tfrac12I\omega**2$$.

title: Formula for the Kinetic Energy of the Bus
text: The kinetic energy of the bus is given by $$KE=\tfrac12mv**2$$.

title: Energy Needed from the Flywheel
text: Only $$90.0\%$$ of the flywheel’s rotational kinetic energy is used to accelerate the bus, so $$E_{\text{rot}}=\frac{KE}{0.900}$$.

title: Moment of Inertia of the Flywheel
text: The flywheel is a disk, so its moment of inertia is $$I=\tfrac12mr**2$$.
